gameLocalization.note: Names follow paired Canto IX part 1/3 records. Valencina follows the enemy record; the guide aliases for Palermitan Rapier / The Cleaving Blade and Shin use their passive IDs. The Eye passive and status have distinct official names. The opening HP reduction, NPC targeting, Eye depletion, Disposal conditions, and 320 HP ending are retained.

lead.text: Lower Lucio to half HP in the opening battle to bring Vergilius in. In the second half, reduce the Nursefather's Eye of Precognition before defeating Lucio. Adjust NPC targets to weaken “Disposal”, which cannot be redirected.

listLead.text: Reducing the opening Apprentice to half HP brings allied reinforcements. Later, reduce the Nursefather's Eye of Precognition before killing the Apprentice. Adjust NPC targets and weaken “Disposal”, whose target cannot be changed.

statNote.text: Heathcliff, Rodion, and Gregor are required. Lucio starts missing 20% of his 1,588 max HP. Reinforcements arrive at 794 HP; Valencina enters with 3,204 HP, 30 SP, 30 Eye of Precognition, and 10 Acceleration Round. Her ending event triggers at 320 HP. Treat Eye-based evasion and acceleration, and NPC Shields, as changing battle effects.

priorities.0.text: Win other clashes before Lucio's major attack to lower its Power and Atk Weight.

priorities.1.text: After reinforcements arrive, direct Vergilius toward the Nursefather to reduce Eye of Precognition.

priorities.2.text: Do not defeat Lucio and trigger “Disposal” while Eye of Precognition remains high.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: Defeating Lucio immediately leads to a wipe

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: Incapacitating Lucio activates Time to Hunt and brings “Disposal”, which scales with Eye of Precognition. Have the NPC reduce the Eye before making this transition.

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: Lucio draws him in through priority clashes and Assist Defense. Have Sinners take over those clashes, then check that the NPC has switched to the Nursefather's dangerous skills.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: A single hit breaks through the Shield

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: Burn and Acceleration Round greatly increase damage against Shields. A 600 Shield is not invincibility. Leave strong skills to the NPC and use healing and clashes.

troubleshooting.3.advice.text: High Eye of Precognition raises Evade Base Power. Use the NPC's many clash rolls to trigger Overloaded; do not invite retaliation by feeding it weak attacks it can evade entirely.

units.0.part.text: Body · Continues from the first half

units.0.notes.0.text: Has 2 Power Down for three turns. This differs from the starting state in 9-3.

units.0.notes.1.text: At the next phase after reaching 794 HP, the Nursefather and assistant enter, and Lucio immediately recovers from Stagger.

units.0.notes.2.text: After the Nursefather enters, interferes with 3 Assist Defense and priority clashes against the NPC. Incapacitating him starts the “Disposal” phase.

units.1.notes.0.text: Enters with 30 Eye of Precognition, 10 Acceleration Round, and 30 SP. The Eye recovers 10 at Turn Start and decreases through Overloaded.

units.1.notes.1.text: After Lucio is incapacitated, focuses on the Game Target and uses “Disposal”.

units.1.notes.2.text: The ending event triggers at 320 HP. You do not need to reduce HP to 0.

phases.0.title.text: Protect the three required Sinners and shared Ampules

phases.0.steps.0.text: Recommended Lv. 60. Level Heathcliff, Rodion, and Gregor, and bring resistance to Slash, Burn, and Tremor, plus HP/SP recovery.

phases.0.steps.1.text: The Sinners share four K Corp. Emergency Ampule uses. Avoid spending too many in the opening battle; save a buffer for later accidents.

phases.0.steps.2.text: Vergilius joins mid-battle; you lose if he dies. Unlike the LCD team, he does not use Assist Defense to cover everyone.

phases.1.title.text: Win the other clashes first to weaken the major attack

phases.1.steps.0.text: “Sezionatura di Cervo” appears from the opening turn. It cannot be redirected, so the targeted Sinner must handle it.

phases.1.steps.1.text: Each earlier clash win against another attack lowers the major skill's Final Power by 2 and Atk Weight by 1, to a minimum of 1. Check action order so other slots resolve before its clasher acts.

phases.1.steps.2.text: Repeated clashes between Lucio and the same Sinner build The Duel Escalates. Rotate clashers while lowering him to 794 HP to bring in reinforcements.

phases.2.title.text: Direct the NPC toward the Nursefather and reduce the Eye first

phases.2.steps.0.text: Lucio interferes through priority clashes with the NPC and Assist Defense. When Sinners take over clashes against Lucio or weaker skills, The Guide changes the NPC's targets. Check that he actually handles the Nursefather's dangerous skills.

phases.2.steps.1.text: Do not focus only on finishing Lucio at this stage. Have the NPC reduce the Nursefather's Eye of Precognition so you can handle “Disposal” when it appears.

phases.2.steps.2.text: Vergilius's 600 Shield is insurance. Burn and Acceleration Round can break through it, so have Sinners stop remaining regular skills and keep healing.

phases.3.timing.text: While Eye of Precognition is high

phases.3.title.text: Reduce it through Overloaded to weaken Evade

phases.3.steps.0.text: Each Eye stack raises “Disposal”'s Base Power and damage. Taking it with all 30 remaining is dangerous even after a clash win.

phases.3.steps.1.text: Once clashes fill Accelerating Future to its cap, each further clash roll reduces the Eye by 1. It also loses 1 when attacked unopposed and 3 on a clash loss. Use the NPC's many clashes.

phases.3.steps.2.text: With the Eye active, an additional Evade triggers. Evading every Coin leads to an unopposed retaliation, so do not pile on weak attacks. If possible, help reduce it with high-Power skills or Counters.

phases.3.steps.3.text: At 0, it changes to Overheat. However, it gains stacks at Turn Start and returns to Eye of Precognition at 30. Evade is not permanently removed.

phases.4.steps.0.text: The Game Target has Speed 1 and is targeted by “Disposal”, which cannot be redirected. Another Sinner cannot forcibly take it over.

phases.4.steps.1.text: The Nursefather also has Speed 1 on “Disposal” turns. Resolve clashes against her other skills first to reduce the Eye as much as possible, then have the target use a strong skill. Heal the target beforehand.

phases.4.steps.2.text: Even a clash win's halved damage and disabled critical hits leave five Unbreakable Coins, Burn, and Tremor Bursts. If the target dies, another Game Target appears next turn; avoid a chain of casualties.

phases.4.steps.3.text: Maintain NPC damage and support until the Nursefather's ending event at 320 HP.

passives.0.effect.text:
Starts the battle missing 20% of max HP.
At Stage Start, gain 2 Power Down for three turns.
Fighting a Color will surely have made him stronger—if he survives to learn from the experience.

passives.0.response.text: Lucio starts missing 20% of max HP and has 2 Power Down for three turns. Avoid spending too many shared Ampules in the opening battle.

passives.1.effect.text:
Gain the following effects according to The Duel Escalates (effects stack):
- Deal and take 10% more damage against its target per stack.
- At 3 or more, gain +1 Clash Power against that target.
- At 5 or more, gain +1 Base Power when clashing with that target.
- At 7 or more, gain +1 Coin Power when clashing with that target.
- At 10 or more, gain +1 Final Power when clashing with that target.

passives.1.response.text: Repeated clashes against the same Sinner become increasingly dangerous. Rotate assignments and use its expiry at the end of a turn without a clash against him.

passives.2.effect.text:
Choose one random target, set their Speed to 1, and target them with every skill.
Activates again every four turns afterward.

passives.2.condition.text: Target selection; every four turns thereafter

passives.2.response.text: Focuses on a Speed 1 Sinner. Distinguish the major attack that cannot be redirected from other skills whose targets can be changed.

passives.3.effect.text:
At Clash End, inflict 1 The Duel Escalates on the clasher.
When clashing with a target with The Duel Escalates, heal 2 SP per stack on the target (max 10).

passives.3.condition.text: End of a clash with Lucio

passives.3.response.text: Builds The Duel Escalates and restores enemy SP. Avoid assigning the same Sinner repeatedly.

passives.4.effect.text: When the user's skill effects trigger Tremor Burst, gain 2 Offense Level Up next turn (up to three times per turn)

passives.4.response.text: Raises next-turn Offense Level. Heal allies with accumulated Burn and Tremor and take the necessary clashes.

passives.5.effect.text:
After the Thumb Nursefather appears, stop using Hunter's Mark and add the following effects:
- If SP is below 30, restore it to 30.
- At Turn Start, gain 3 Assist Defense.
- Can clash regardless of Speed.
- Prioritize clashes with Vergilius.
- When the Thumb Nursefather wins a clash, use “Colpi Sottani” for an unopposed attack at the end of that attack (twice per turn).
“Could I kill her now?”

Watching his sleeping teacher, Lucio always returned to that thought. Fear ingrained in him, and gratitude toward the person who had taken him out of the Backstreets, kept him from acting. Yet his resentment ran deep. Even as he promised heartfelt obedience, he swore to kill her after this battle—to cut and stab even her remaining eye. For the first time, life began to return to the eyes of the bruised boy.

passives.5.response.text: Lucio interferes with 3 Assist Defense and priority clashes against the NPC. Have Sinners take over so the NPC can handle the Nursefather. Do not prioritize an immediate kill.

passives.6.effect.text: If Panicked at Turn End, reset SP to 0.

passives.6.response.text: SP returns to 0. Do not assume sustained Panic alone will stop the enemy.

passives.7.effect.text: When gaining a buff that changes Panic Type, Panic Type stays unchanged. Apply the effects intended for targets without SP instead.

passives.7.response.text: Do not rely on replacing Panic Type to disable powerful actions.

passives.8.effect.text:
On entering the stage, gain 30 Eye of Precognition.
At 0 stacks, Eye of Precognition changes to Eye of Precognition - Overheat.
The relic called Odin's Eye is actually one fragment of another relic split into three.

passives.8.response.text: Reduce it from 30 to 0 to enter Overheat. Lowering it before “Disposal” is essential.

passives.9.effect.text:
Gain 1 Accelerating Future per clash.
Each turn, it can be gained up to (Eye of Precognition at Turn Start ÷ 3).
With Eye of Precognition active, being attacked unopposed or losing a clash activates “Precognition”.
“With every exchange this blade will heat up and keep accelerating until I reach the future I saw.”

passives.9.condition.text: Each clash; Evade on unopposed attacks or clash losses

passives.9.response.text: The enemy accelerates as clashes continue. After reaching the cap, further clash rolls reduce the Eye.

passives.10.effect.text:
Reduce Eye of Precognition under these conditions:
- If Accelerating Future cannot be gained, lose 1 Eye per clash roll.
- When attacked unopposed, lose 1 Eye.
- On Clash Lose, lose 3 Eye.
“My eye throbs with pain and heat, and my vision turns red.”

passives.10.condition.text: Clashes after the acceleration cap; unopposed attacks; clash losses

passives.10.response.text: The main mechanism for reducing the Eye. Use the NPC's many clashes rather than repeatedly using only weak Sinner attacks.

passives.11.effect.text:
HP damage, SP damage, and Stagger Threshold advancement from Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking are reduced by 30%.
With at least 1 Acceleration Round, skills that consume rounds deal 30% more damage and 150% more damage to Shields.
Gain 4 Poise per 4 rounds consumed.
Coins that consume rounds still attack when no rounds remain.
“You were taught Palermo and even inherited a family heirloom, yet you disgrace yourself like this.”
“We will not reclaim your inherited relic and sword; your dishonor has already stained them.”
“Valencina, surely no one else has been dismissed just three days after becoming Underboss.”
“You are a disgrace to the famiglia. Bognatelli withdraws its love from you.”

passives.11.response.text: Rounds greatly increase damage against Shields. Running out does not cancel the attack itself.

passives.12.effect.text:
Damage to Shields +15% per Burn on the main target (max 300%).
On Skill Use, if the target's Attack Skill is Slash or Pierce, Clash Power +1.
When the user's skill effects trigger Tremor Burst, gain 2 Damage Up next turn (up to three times per turn).
When the user's skill effects trigger a critical hit, heal 5 SP.

passives.12.condition.text: Target's Burn; clashes against Slash or Pierce

passives.12.response.text: Burn increases damage against Shields. Your attack type can also improve the enemy's clashes, so check predictions.

passives.13.effect.text:
When damaged, or when The Thumb Apprentice - Lucio is incapacitated, gain Shin (心) - Valencina next turn.
“Phew... So I just slip in and raise hell like that fanatic planned... Will that really get my ticket back?”

passives.13.response.text: Expect buffs next turn. Actions and Power do not remain unchanged after Lucio falls.

passives.14.effect.text: When The Thumb Apprentice - Lucio is incapacitated, activate Time to Hunt

passives.14.response.text: Starts Time to Hunt. Reduce the Eye sufficiently before making this transition.

passives.15.effect.text:
At Turn Start, clear Stagger if Staggered.

Choose one random Sinner and apply Game Target.
- Activates once every four turns afterward.
- Activates again next turn if “Disposal” kills its target.
Palermo swordsmanship embodies Famiglia Bognatelli's temperament: relentlessly pursue, hunt, and dismember a single quarry. It rejects stealth, killing openly before witnesses with honor and dignity. Its elegant swordsmanship brought many honors and raised Bognatelli into the Seven Great Famiglie of the Backstreets. Valencina mastered Palermo, beheaded many officers and veteran soldiers in the Smoke War, and became one of its heroes. Yet who could have foreseen that this fame would become her shackle?

passives.15.condition.text: On activation; every four turns; after a “Disposal” kill

passives.15.response.text: A target's death creates another target next turn. Do not allow repeated “Disposal” attacks while the Eye remains high.

passives.16.effect.text: If Panicked at Turn End, reset SP to 0.

passives.16.response.text: SP returns to 0. Do not assume sustained Panic alone will stop the enemy.

passives.17.effect.text: When gaining a buff that changes Panic Type, Panic Type stays unchanged. Apply the effects intended for targets without SP instead.

passives.17.response.text: Do not rely on replacing Panic Type to disable powerful actions.

mechanics.0.effect.text: When taking lethal damage while another ally is alive, clear Stagger and fully restore HP. Every ally's remaining Ampule count decreases by 1 simultaneously.

mechanics.0.response.text: The Sinners share four uses in this battle. These are not separate counts per Sinner.

mechanics.1.effect.text: Maximum 20. Increases after clashes with Lucio and strengthens Power and damage dealt/taken against its target. Expires at the end of a turn without a clash against him.

mechanics.1.response.text: Rotate assignments instead of concentrating stacks on one Sinner.

mechanics.2.effect.text: Maximum 30; Clash Power +2. At Turn Start, gain 10 stacks and heal SP equal to stacks ÷ 4. Strengthens Evade and “Disposal”.

mechanics.2.response.text: Reduce it before defeating Lucio, and resolve other clashes first immediately before “Disposal” too.

mechanics.3.effect.text: The Overheat state entered at 0 Eye. Attack damage −20%. Converts all Coins of skills that consume Acceleration Round to Unbreakable Coins. Gains 10 stacks at Turn Start and returns to Eye of Precognition at 30.

mechanics.3.response.text: Both weakening and Unbreakable conversion apply. Check the actual effects rather than focusing on variations in the translated Overheat label.

mechanics.4.effect.text: Maximum 10. Clash Power +1 per stack; Coin Power +1 per 5 stacks. The gain cap each turn is Eye of Precognition at Turn Start ÷ 3.

mechanics.4.response.text: After the cap, clash rolls trigger Overloaded. Do not use an opening prediction to judge the entire turn.

mechanics.5.effect.text: Maximum 10. Rounds consumed by specific Coins. While available, affected skills deal 30% more damage and 150% more damage to Shields.

mechanics.5.response.text: Running out does not stop attacks. Do not rely solely on Shields.

mechanics.6.effect.text: Speed fixed at 1; targeted by all of Valencina's attacks.

mechanics.6.response.text: “Disposal” cannot be redirected. Prepare the marked Sinner's own skill and heal them beforehand.

mechanics.7.effect.text: Vergilius's attack targets change according to Sinner assignments.

mechanics.7.response.text: Have Sinners take over weaker skills assigned to the NPC, then check that he switches to the Nursefather's dangerous skills.

warnings.0.text: Defeating Lucio sooner is not always better. Reduce the Eye sufficiently before entering the “Disposal” phase.

warnings.1.text: Vergilius does not provide Assist Defense like the LCD team. Use his Shields and adjust his attack targets.

warnings.2.text: “Disposal” cannot be redirected. With high Eye stacks, it is dangerous even after a clash win.

warnings.3.text: If “Precognition” evades every Coin, it retaliates. Do not repeatedly feed it only weak attacks.

warnings.4.text: Overheat conditionally makes round-consuming skills Unbreakable. Running out of rounds does not cancel attacks either.

warnings.5.text: Do not apply the hidden Mirror Dungeon boss's resistances, damage, or Lucio kill order to normal 9-42.

preparation.0.text: Recommended Lv. 60 with Heathcliff, Rodion, and Gregor. Bring Slash resistance, HP/SP recovery, and high-Power skills.

preparation.1.text: Slash works well against both Lucio and the Nursefather. Prioritize NPC assignments and Eye management before affinity.

roles.0.reason.text: Weaken his opening major attack, then direct the NPC toward the Nursefather in the second half.

roles.1.reason.text: Use NPC clashes and Overloaded to weaken “Disposal”.

roles.2.name.text: Heal the target and prepare a strong clash

roles.2.reason.text: Survive “Disposal” without redirection and prevent repeated target generation.

messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)9-42「ルチオ・ヴァレンチーナ（9-4: Lucio & Valencina (9-42) guide for Limbus Company 9-42. Lower Lucio to half HP in the opening battle to bring Vergilius in. In the second half, reduce the Nursefather's Eye of Precognition before defeating Lucio. Adjust NPC targets to weaken “Disposal”, which cannot be redirected.
